details: Battle trait. In your movement phase, pick a friendly unit that is in the tunnels below.
Set up that unit wholly within 6 inches of a corner of the battlefield and more than 9 inches from all enemy units.
Remember: units left in the tunnels below that have not used Gnawhole Ambush by the end of the third battle round are destroyed.
